culpritSource.quote: The real culprit was Toru Tsukano. His original plan was to steal the land deed that his late sister (Ishigaki's wife) had left him, but which Ishigaki had taken after he had caught Tsukano embezzling money from his company. Ishigaki caught him while looking through the painting and threatened to press charges, so Tsukano ended up killing him. He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents.

motive.zhHans: 他原本的计划是偷走那份土地契约——那是他已故的姐姐（Ishigaki 的妻子）留给他的，但 Ishigaki 在发现 Tsukano 挪用其公司款项后把契约拿走了。当 Iwamatsu 逃离现场、听到 Iwamatsu 摔倒在地的女管家赶到案发现场时，Tsukano 决定假装自己刚刚抵达，并检查了受害者，好为手上的血找个借口。
motive.en: His original plan was to steal the land deed that his late sister (Ishigaki's wife) had left him, but which Ishigaki had taken after he had caught Tsukano embezzling money from his company. When Iwamatsu had fled the scene and the housekeeper, who had heard Iwamatsu hitting the ground, rushed to the crime scene, Tsukano decided to pretend that he had just arrived, and checked the victim so that he would have an excuse for the blood on his hands.

method.zhHans: 他在画的背面找到了那份契约，Ishigaki 平时把最重要的文件藏在这里。然而 Ishigaki 刚被杀死，Iwamatsu 就来了，于是 Tsukano 又把画挂了回去（匆忙中没注意到画已经挂反了），自己躲到门后。当 Iwamatsu 逃离现场、听到 Iwamatsu 摔倒在地的女管家赶到案发现场时，Tsukano 决定假装自己刚刚抵达，并检查了受害者，好为手上的血找个借口。
method.en: He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents. Right after Ishigaki was killed, however, Iwamatsu came, so Tsukano hung the painting up again (failing to notice in his haste that it was now upside down) and hid behind the door. When Iwamatsu had fled the scene and the housekeeper, who had heard Iwamatsu hitting the ground, rushed to the crime scene, Tsukano decided to pretend that he had just arrived, and checked the victim so that he would have an excuse for the blood on his hands.

evidence.zhHans: 他在画的背面找到了那份契约，Ishigaki 平时把最重要的文件藏在这里。但在把凶器从花瓶里取出来时，他在里面留下了带血的指纹，这成为指认他就是凶手的关键证据。
evidence.en: He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents. But while removing the murder weapon from the vase, he left blooded fingerprints inside, which became the crucial evidence about him being the culprit.

resolution.zhHans: 真正的凶手是 Toru Tsukano。他原本的计划是偷走那份土地契约——那是他已故的姐姐（Ishigaki 的妻子）留给他的，但 Ishigaki 在发现 Tsukano 挪用其公司款项后把契约拿走了。Ishigaki 在翻看那幅画时撞见了他，并威胁要起诉，于是 Tsukano 最终杀死了他。他在画的背面找到了那份契约，Ishigaki 平时把最重要的文件藏在这里。
resolution.en: The real culprit was Toru Tsukano. His original plan was to steal the land deed that his late sister (Ishigaki's wife) had left him, but which Ishigaki had taken after he had caught Tsukano embezzling money from his company. Ishigaki caught him while looking through the painting and threatened to press charges, so Tsukano ended up killing him. He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents.
